title: sideritis hirsuta subsp. pourretii
intro: Sideritis hirsuta subsp. pourretii, commonly known as Pourret's mountain tea or Cretan ironwort, is a plant species within the genus Sideritis, which is a group of flowering plants belonging to the mint family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly its ability to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities. The health benefits of Sideritis hirsuta subsp. pourretii include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory issues, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects, which can contribute to its therapeutic use in treating conditions such as bronchitis and coughs. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties.
